recipe: Copy all canonical Codec files and both adapter manifest/status files byte-for-byte; reconstruct same-inode pending aliases, including index names. Exclude only prior external acceptance/validation controls so a new read-only validator must recompute all checks. No source record deleted/rewritten, no logical field excluded or normalized, no new events.
not_a_retry_of_failed_validator: Previous target attempt stopped in synthetic data construction; this is a separate validation-only fixture experiment, not generator resume or an increased deadline.
control_projection_clarification: Only previous external acceptance/validation controls omitted from the derived view. All logical records, array blobs, indices, receipts, manifest/status and inner completion files retain exact source bytes. Original captures and old proofs unchanged.
input_transfer_and_archive_storage: Technical input/staging assets outside the Observer capture trees; all Codec blobs are regular in-tree files, not external references. Per-capture whole-tree4GiB remains enforced.
purpose: Separate target validation-only experiment, no regeneration or retry of a timed-out validation on the same fixture.
